<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml"
       xmlns:event="https://github.com/stateforward/scxml.rs/namespaces/event"
       version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="idle">
  <state id="idle">
    <transition event="order" target="done" event:schema="event-schemas/missing.json"/>
    <transition event="refund" target="done" event:schema="../order.json"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>
